name: CapCut
tagline: Short-form video editing with auto captions and templates
description: ByteDance video editor with auto captions, trend templates, background removal and AI generation, made for short-form content teams that publish every day.
priceNote: Pro is around $9.99 per month on annual billing through the web store, while app store and web prices differ and a newer Standard tier starts near $19.99/month; the free tier caps export at 1080p. Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Social teams publishing short-form video daily on a tight budget
pros: Auto captions with animated word highlighting are the fastest social caption workflow we tested
A large template library makes daily posts possible with almost no editing skill required
Background removal and auto cut handle the awkward edits that normally cost an hour
The editor runs in the browser with no install, and the free tier is enough to try it
cons: Pricing is inconsistent: the same Pro plan costs roughly twice as much in the app store
CapCut belongs to ByteDance, so media and project data sit under a Chinese parent company
The free plan exports at 1080p and adds a watermark on several asset types
Heavy editing stutters on older laptops, and the mobile app drains battery quickly

features.name: Auto captions
features.detail: Transcribes speech and styles captions with animated word highlighting

features.name: Templates and trends
features.detail: Ready-made formats that follow current social trends and formats

features.name: Background removal
features.detail: Isolates a subject from video or stills in a single click

features.name: AI generation
features.detail: Script drafts, stock video, voice tracks and text-to-video helpers

features.name: Effects and transitions
features.detail: Large library of trends, filters and keyframe animations

features.name: Desktop and mobile
features.detail: Browser, desktop and phone editors with synced projects

useCases: Turn a webinar recording into three captioned clips for LinkedIn in under an hour
Post daily short-form content for a small brand without a video editor on payroll
Cut product demos for a small e-commerce catalogue and add subtitles for reach
Localise client videos by swapping captions and audio tracks per market
bestForWho: Social and content teams that publish short video daily and want captions and templates more than fine control.
verdict: CapCut is the tool that made short-form video a daily task rather than a production project, and for a small brand the caption workflow alone justifies it. Auto captions with animated word highlighting are genuinely faster than anything else we tested, and the template library covers trends you would otherwise rebuild from scratch each week. The practical warning is pricing: the same plan costs roughly double if you subscribe through the app store, so buy on the web and keep the subscription in one place. The other thing worth stating plainly is ownership, because ByteDance is the parent company and that matters to agencies and clients with strict data rules. For daily social output on a budget, it is hard to beat; for brand work with legal review, look elsewhere.
